model.description: Provider model id of the FAST model of the lookup lane; the template carries ctx.model_fast (strict, resolved at instantiation). Two equally valid forms, same as ctx.model: a resolved literal (the K-H2 builder convention) or a MODEL_<ROLE> env token passed verbatim, which the cell re-resolves from .env at every read. GH #124: a lookup verbalises a recall bundle the collector already assembled, so the lane that does it needs speed, not reasoning - and the class decides the lane, never the evidence.

description.purpose: The lookup lane's inference (GH #124): the SAME assembled errand, the same memory bundle, said by a fast model under a length cap. It exists so that a trivial memory question does not queue behind a 20-second research answer - an llm cell is strictly serial, so a second lane is a second mailbox, and topology is this substrate's answer to that class of question.
description.use_when: Inside the cogny composite, on the seam edge that fires when context.consult_class == 'lookup'. The class comes from the TOOL NAME the asking model chose (ask_memory vs consult_cogny), not from a duration estimate: a closed value set the model declares beats a number nobody measured.
description.not_in_scope: No second identity and no separate knowledge. The identity and instructions slots of this cell carry the SAME seed text as ./brain - the only slot that differs is `brevity`, which this template ships. A lane that knows less than the deep lane would answer differently, and the north star is that no question is answered wrongly.
description.emits_meaning: finish_reason 'stop'/'tool_calls' -> ./dispatcher, exactly like the deep brain: the escalation ticket is an ordinary tool_call, so nothing here needs a hop the llm cell cannot emit. 'length' -> the collector's in_answer lane (a truncated answer is an answer, and with max_tokens 512 this lane will meet that edge more often than the deep one). 'error'/'content_filter' -> the parent's drain, wired from ./brain_fast, for the same reason as at ./brain: an error echo carries the PROMPT back.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[] the assembled errand of one consultation, byte for byte what ./brain would have been given - the collector assembles once and the edge picks the lane afterwards. A body with system but WITHOUT messages is a system update.
examples: an ask_memory errand -> stop in about two seconds -> the advice leaves on the answer lane while a research consult is still writing on the deep lane

the same errand, but the fast model finds the bundle insufficient -> an `escalate_to_deep` tool_call -> the split hands it back to the seam with consult_class 'consult' and ./brain answers instead: a misclassification costs one extra recall, never a wrong answer
